name: ligerbots-carpool-backend
description: Automation for Ligerbots Backend (running Directus over PostGreSQL)

scripts.service:restart: npm run service:stop && npm run service:start
scripts.extensions:install: npm run extensions:remove && npm run extensions:extract
scripts.directus:schema:backup: docker exec -it directus npx directus schema snapshot 1>schema.yaml
scripts.db:restore: cat backup.sql | docker exec -i database psql -h ${npm_package_config_db_host} -U ${npm_package_config_db_user} -d ${npm_package_config_db_name}

author: Rob Raisch <raisch@gmail.com>
